name: Imp
description: a small wiry hell imp, one of the Overlord's raiders: crimson leathery skin, short curled horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, a little sack of stolen glittering diamonds slung over its shoulder, a glowing orange ember cupped in one clawed hand

poses.stand: hovering in mid-air on spread bat wings, legs dangling, the ember held up in one hand
poses.dead: dropping out of the air, crumbling into a cloud of grey ash and dying embers

idle.action: hovers in place, flapping its bat wings steadily, tail swishing, tossing the ember from hand to hand

attack.action: winds its arm back and hurls the glowing ember forward to the right, then hovers again

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a yelp, wings crumpling, then recovers

die.action: is hit, stiffens, and crumbles into grey ash and fading embers that fall away
